summary: Intermittent p95 latency spikes for embeddings during cross-region DNS handoff and LB session reassignment
description: Issue summary: Customer reports intermittent p95 latency spikes (~600-800ms additional) for bulk embedding requests originating from their private VPC. Spikes correlate with small windows where requests are routed across regions (us-east -> eu-west) during DNS handoffs and load balancer session reassignment. Impact: User-facing slowdown in document ingestion pipelines, increased client-side timeouts and retries. Scope: Reported for a single enterprise customer on a Private deployment; similar traffic patterns not yet observed for other customers.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer runs a 1000-item embedding batch from their VPC (region: us-east) with concurrency 8. 2) Observe time-series of per-request p95 over a 2 hour window. 3) During periodic DNS refreshes or LB rebalances, some requests get routed to eu-west resulting in increased cold-kv-cache latency and additional inter-region egress time. 4) Reproduces intermittently, approximately every 5-15 minutes during periods of background LB activity.
logs: Selected traces: request IDs e0a3f9b2, e0a3f9f8, e0a3fb11 show backend hop: gateway->us-east-pool->eu-west-fallback; header X-Route-Reason: dns-cache-evicted; LB cookie session_id mismatch logs at 2026-03-10T14:03:22Z. No 5xx errors; increased tail token generation time and KV cache miss counters during the windows. See S3 traces at s3://redwood-support/sup-221900/traces/*.log
investigation_notes: Timeline: 2026-03-10 13:50 UTC initial report by CS. 13:55 assigned to SRE. Hypotheses considered: 1) DNS TTL expiration in customer VPC causing client to resolve to different edge region; 2) Load-balancer session affinity cookie TTL too short leading to LB reassignments; 3) Smart-routing fallback policy incorrectly preferring eu-west for small subset of traffic; 4) Cold KV cache on target region increasing per-request latency. Findings: - DNS records showed TTL 60s from customer's internal resolver; logs show client-side resolution frequently falling back to eu-west during DNS refresh. - LB session cookie lifespan is 30s for the affected pool; multiple reassignments logged near TTL expiry. - KV cache miss ratio spikes line up with region-crossing requests, adding ~350ms on average. - No model-version fallbacks observed; model pinned correctly. Next steps: apply mitigation and test with customer to confirm.
comments: 2026-03-10 14:02 - CS (Maya Chen): Customer noticing increased retries in ingestion job after 13:30 UTC. Provided request IDs and batch window screenshots.

2026-03-10 14:10 - SRE (Diego Martinez): Collected daemon logs, routing headers. Early signal points to DNS handoff + LB cookie TTL. Investigating whether smart-routing TTL interacts with LB decision.
2026-03-11 09:24 - Networking (Liam O'Connor): Confirmed LB cookie configured to 30s for ephemeral pools. Suggest increasing to 300s for private pools behind VPC to reduce reassignments.

2026-03-12 16:40 - Eng (Priya Singh): Deployed prototype change to region_preference flag for this customer's private control plane to prefer us-east for the session. Also warmed KV cache in eu-west with a backfill job to reduce remote cold misses.
2026-03-13 10:12 - CS (Maya Chen): Customer reports reduced p95 spikes after changes; still monitoring for full regression. Recommended follow-up items captured below.
resolution: Mitigations applied: increased LB session cookie TTL for customer's private pool from 30s -> 300s; toggled region_preference to strong-prefer us-east for this customer's control plane; executed targeted KV cache warm-up in eu-west to reduce cold misses. Customer-side recommendation: increase internal DNS cache TTL where possible and batch with slight jitter. Outcome: CS reports p95 reduced to acceptable SLA levels (previous 1200-1400ms spikes now under 250ms additional). Follow-up: monitor for 72 hours, plan permanent config change in Dedicated/private rollout, and add a note to Private VPC onboarding docs about DNS and LB TTL best practices.
postmortem_followup_tasks: Add DNS/TTL guidance to Private onboarding docs
Automate region_preference toggle for emergency mitigation
Add a monitoring alert for KV cache miss correlated with cross-region egress events
